_note: Chief Marlow, the deck chief (narrative::marlow). He is a real crew member aboard, and he can die. While he is aboard, 'marlow' lines are used and cards are headed with 'kicker'. Once he is dead (or on a save from before he was aboard) the ship speaks for itself: 'ship' lines, headed with 'ship_kicker', and the moments are not said at all. Keys are written in [BRACKETS]. Plain ASCII only: the game font has no em-dash or curly quotes. 'tutorial' is the shakedown, one entry per step in order (src/tutorial.rs STEPS); do not add or remove entries without changing STEPS. Keep moments to one or two short sentences: they are shown as a toast, not a card.
name: Marlow
death: Chief Marlow is dead. Nobody on the deck answers for him. The ship will have to say things itself.
burial: Marlow committed to space. The deck has no chief.

moments.hail: That was the Silence. They don't call anyone. I'd go.
moments.commission: Seven pieces of a meeting nobody admits to. Fine. It's work, and she pays.
moments.errands_done: That's the Princes' price in the safe. I counted it twice.
moments.piece_1: An observer, seated for the record. I've read your serial plate. I'm not saying anything.
moments.piece_2: In two places at once. I've had watches like that. Titanium's good, though.
moments.piece_3: That's one of your status reports. I've read a thousand of them. That's yours.
moments.piece_4: She stopped counting at a billion. I count two hundred and forty, and I know their names.
moments.carry: Into the scar, then. I'll check the ward myself before we jump.
moments.last_one: The last one. They said it like a price.
moments.first_dark: That system had lights last time anyone looked. Now it doesn't.
moments.mirror: That's our hull out there. Plate for plate. Don't let it get behind us.
moments.first_burial: We do this properly. Every time. Even out here.
moments.ward_failing: Ward's going. Whatever you came in here for, be quick about it.
moments.reached: We're at Haven. Don't ask me how. Nobody aboard wants to talk about it.
moments.ghost_contact: Radar had something. Then it didn't. I've logged it as nothing.
moments.meridian: CSS Meridian. Same yard as us, same year. I knew her chief.
moments.sister_hail: That was a Halyard-class transponder. There aren't supposed to be any left.
moments.refugees: Haulers full of people, all going one way. Away from something.
moments.site: Eleven ships, all still at their berths. One berth empty. I think it's ours.

breach.title: We're holed
breach.marlow: Air's going out through the gap, and anyone in that room goes with it. Press [Q] to see the air. The crew will seal it if they can reach it, and the doors hold the rest of the ship. Keep that side out of the fight until they do.
breach.ship: Hull breach. Air is leaving through the gap, and anyone in that room leaves with it. [Q] shows the air. The crew will seal it if they can reach it, and the doors hold the rest. Keep that side out of the fight until they do.

turret_deck.title: The turret deck
turret_deck.marlow: Everything that turns sits up here. A gun is a firing piece with loaders behind it and barrel in front of it. Its shells come up the hoist from a magazine on the deck below. Leave turrets room to swing: crowd them and they jam on each other. [PgUp] again for the armoured roof.
turret_deck.ship: The turret deck: everything that turns. A gun is a firing piece with loaders behind it and barrel in front of it. Shells come up the hoist from a magazine on the deck below. Turrets need room to swing, and jam on each other when crowded. [PgUp] again for the armoured roof.

brownout.title: Running short of power
brownout.marlow: We're drawing more than the reactors make, so weapons, shields and engines are all running slow. [U] shows where the power goes. Back home, add reactors or take something off.
brownout.ship: Draw exceeds reactor output. Weapons, shields and engines are all running slow. [U] shows where the power goes. At a station, add reactors or remove a load.

tutorial.marlow: Core's up. Good. I'm Marlow, deck chief. You're the Halyard's mind now, and we're its hands. We're berthed at Haven. When you're ready, take us out: Launch [Enter].
tutorial.ship: Core online. No deck chief answers. Berthed at Haven. Launch: [Enter].

tutorial.marlow: The block at the bottom right is the ship. HULL is what's still holding, POWER is reactor output against what we're drawing, FUEL burns whenever you thrust, and CREW is us. Keep an eye on all four.
tutorial.ship: Bottom right: ship status. HULL is what still holds. POWER is reactor output against draw. FUEL burns under thrust. CREW is the hands aboard. All four matter.

tutorial.marlow: The nose follows your cursor. [W] burns forward, [S] backs off, [A] and [D] slide us sideways. Give her a push.
tutorial.ship: The nose follows the cursor. [W] burns forward, [S] reverses, [A] and [D] translate sideways. Apply thrust.

tutorial.marlow: Press [.] to look inside the hull. That's all of us in there, and the air we breathe. [Q] shows the air itself. Press [.] again to come back out.
tutorial.ship: [.] shows the inside of the hull: the crew, and the air they breathe. [Q] shows the air itself. [.] again returns outside.

tutorial.marlow: Out here you find things by listening. [Z] pings the radar: anything in range shows up. Try it.
tutorial.ship: Contacts are found by listening. [Z] pings the radar. Anything in range answers.

tutorial.marlow: Contact. A raider, a light one. Right-click it to lock on. We'll hold the best range for our guns on our own.
tutorial.ship: Contact: one raider, light. Right-click it to lock on. Best gun range is held automatically.

tutorial.marlow: Hold [Space] or the left button to fire. The turrets turn by themselves; the big one is slow, but it hits like a hammer. Don't waste shells on empty space.
tutorial.ship: [Space] or the left button fires. Turrets train themselves. The large one is slow and hits hardest. Shells are finite.

tutorial.marlow: Scratch one. The pay is in the wreck: get in close and press [F]. Anyone off shift suits up and strips it.
tutorial.ship: Target destroyed. The value is in the wreck. Close in and press [F]. Off-shift crew suit up and strip it.

tutorial.marlow: What they carry back is cargo, not credits. We sell it at a station. Hunt, salvage, sell, build: that's how the Halyard gets stronger.
tutorial.ship: Salvage is cargo, not credits. It is sold at a station. Hunt, salvage, sell, build: that is how this hull gets stronger.

tutorial.marlow: Take us home. Ease up to Haven and dock with [F].
tutorial.ship: Return to Haven. Approach slowly and dock with [F].

tutorial.marlow: Home. This is where we spend it: the shipyard, the station's services and the crew roster.
tutorial.ship: Docked. Credits are spent here: the shipyard, the station's services and the crew roster.

tutorial.marlow: [B] opens the shipyard. Everything you place draws power, so match it with reactors. The Guns tab opens with ready-made guns, then the parts to build your own. Outside the yard, right-click any of our guns to tune its shells.
tutorial.ship: [B] opens the shipyard. Every block placed draws power: match it with reactors. The Guns tab lists ready-made guns, then the parts to build others. Outside the yard, right-click a gun to tune its shells.

tutorial.marlow: Shut the shipyard with [B]. [U] opens the station's services: fuel, repairs, selling what we salvage. The tabs run along the top, and [E] turns to the next. Find the Comm directory. At a faction's port that's where the people with work are, and who we work for decides who shoots at us.
tutorial.ship: Shut the shipyard with [B]. [U] opens the station's services: fuel, repairs, selling salvage. Tabs run along the top, and [E] turns to the next. Find the Comm directory. At a faction's port it lists the people with work. Who is worked for decides who opens fire.

tutorial.marlow: [C] is the roster, [H] to hire. A station nobody's manning runs at a fraction. We're what make her work.
tutorial.ship: [C] is the roster, [H] hires. An unmanned station runs at a fraction of its rate. The crew are what make this hull work.

tutorial.marlow: That's the shakedown. One more thing: someone's been trying to raise us since you woke up. [M] is the map, and [L] keeps every record we find. Take us out when you're ready.
tutorial.ship: Shakedown complete. One more thing: something has been trying to raise this ship since the core came up. [M] is the map. [L] keeps every record found. Launch when ready.
